_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `Procedural2dMutation` is a semio-NATIVE vocabulary carried in `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio`, so no oracle is registered and the decision below records what stands in for one.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: No third-party library reads or writes semio's own `.dsl.semio`/`.pack.semio` envelope, and none is authoritative over `Procedural2dMutation` — a vocabulary that differs from its 3d sibling exactly where the two documents' editing models differ: whole-value `replace-widget`/`replace-synapse` instead of field-wise `update-*`, and a document-wide `clear-widget-layout` instead of a per-widget `delete-widget-position`. Which of those two shapes is correct for this subset IS the specification, not a fact an external node-graph library could confirm or refute. Confidence comes instead from the committed specification vectors under `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/<kind>/🧪️tests/<fixture>/` — one handcrafted `(before, mutation, diff, outcome, after)` quintet per kind, already unit-tested inside the production crate — replayed end-to-end through the test platform here, plus two metamorphic laws asserted in role: observability (a kind must move the compared projection) and footprint completeness (`before` and `after` may differ on exactly the fields the committed diff declares).
